name: Salsify

schedule.notes: Use FRESH seed — viability drops fast. Loose, stone-free soil for straight roots.
After hard frosts — frost sweetens. Lift carefully; roots are 8 to 12 in long and break easily.

harvest.cues: Roots 1 in across at the shoulder, 8 to 12 in long, creamy white. Tops are bluish-green, grass-like.
harvest.storageNotes: Mulch and overwinter in ground (best); or store in damp sand at 32 to 40 F for 3 to 4 months.

notes: Called 'oyster plant' for the mild oyster-like flavor when peeled and simmered. Roots discolor fast when peeled — submerge in acidulated water immediately. Niche but classic in French and Italian cooking.
